verdict.rationale: Bento's Subscribers API supports filtering by tags, segments, and date ranges (bento-docs-8) and bulk create/update (bento-docs-14), and the CLI/API could be scripted to pull subscriber data (bento-docs-4), implying some self-serve data-extraction capability. However, there is no explicit documentation of a one-click 'export all data' feature, no confirmation of CSV/open-format export, and no mention of exporting the suppression list or engagement history specifically — only 'migration help' is offered as a vendor-assisted service (bento-docs-11), not a self-serve export. missing for 10: explicit export/download feature documentation, confirmation of open format (CSV/JSON) output, explicit inclusion of suppression list and engagement history in export scope.
